purpose: Separate supervision-set effects from graph architecture effects before scaling
baseline_version: v6 frozen; new development pilot only
encoder: Qwen3-0.6B frozen object encoder; promote to 1.7B only after pilot

fixed.prefix_sampling: same train-derived optimal prefixes for all arms
fixed.deployment_masks: identical structural masks; no gold or optimal-continuation masks

selection.train_groups: fixed hash selection of original train groups; no test groups
selection.development: original dev plus separate train-derived rename/number/redundancy/no-op probes
selection.final_test: new frozen confirmation set after mechanism selection; existing v6 test is retrospective

budget.calibration: time 100 updates and count encoder/label-generation costs before admission

gates.continue_to_three_seeds: dev challenge faithful +5pp vs strongest same-budget baseline; N deviation <= baseline+1pp; no mask exclusion of accepted plans
gates.stop_scaling: gain <3pp or fails entirely after parameter/name interventions; retain negative result
gates.graph_retention: incremental gain over dense_set, not merely over dense_single
gates.contrastive_branch: only after set-target baseline; feasibility-checked multi-positive targets; same candidates and full backward through both scores

implementation_state.graph_policy_and_full_trainer: not yet implemented; config is not a runnable training claim
